draft.name: Sky Captain
draft.description: Brass telescope extended, Sky Captain scans teal-tinted skies. He marks the map with an ink-stained quill, each X a stolen treasure's secret. At the helm, he hums like a storm's approach.

reviews.note: Reads as an office clerk, not a sky-pirate: business suit and tie in a wood-panelled cabin, no teal and no airship deck.
